NOT confirmed: the 2026 commencement date (15-08-2026) rests on India Code's own footnotes (MoRTH S.O. 4100(E), 24-07-2026, not read); the 2019 commencement notifications for 1-9-2019, 1-4-2021 and 1-7-2021 were not read; India Code's stored checksum for this file differs from the served bytes (cause unresolved); not a Gazette print; currency after 15-08-2026 not established. Contains no penalty sections (Chapter XIII is not included). The Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 (which prescribe forms, documents, fees and tests) are NOT in the knowledge base.
